All eight single-source adapters reject the joint selection and preserve both complete final sources. Since fixture supplied IDs only, IDs themselves served as explicitly opaque payloads; no semantic case was invented.
All forty retained entries remain, ten real adapters have concrete contracts, other entries have none, and challenge names/IDs do not occur in catalog or policy.
